summary: BSTR Holdings, Inc. and BSTR Newco, LLC filed an 8-K disclosing a loan agreement where Newco borrowed $2.5 million from BSTR Holdings (Cayman) to fund operating costs and transaction expenses related to a pending business combination. The loan bears interest at SOFR plus 3.90%, payable annually, with principal due at closing of the business combination, dissolution, or two years from signing. This is a routine financing arrangement to support an ongoing transaction, not an independent special situation.
